title: Warm Creamy Middle Eastern Chickpeas Falafel
description: A comforting and earthy Middle Eastern dish featuring crispy falafel in a rich and creamy coconut sauce, perfect for a sick day. This jain-friendly recipe is made with garlic powder and coconut cream.
instructions: In a food processor, combine chickpeas, flour, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper, and process until well combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 falafel patties.
Place the falafel on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through.
In a large saucepan, heat the coconut cream over medium heat.
Add the lemon juice and olive oil to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Once the falafel are done baking, add them to the saucepan and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Serve the falafel hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
